blocks.orig: The Mount Meru Game Lodge & Sanctuary is located just outside Arusha near the Usa River and the Mount Meru Wildlife Sanctuary. The reserve has zebras, ostriches, various monkey species and exotic birds. This luxury lodge is set up in colonial style and the spacious rooms are fully equipped. There is also a swimming pool and in the evening you can enjoy a drink by the campfire in the beautiful garden.
blocks.html: Just outside Arusha, close to the Usa River and the Mount Meru Wildlife Sanctuary, you find The Mount Meru Game Lodge & Sanctuary. In the reserve live zebras, ostriches, several kinds of monkeys and exotic birds. The luxury lodge is furnished in colonial style, and its roomy rooms have everything you need. There is a swimming pool too, and in the evening you can have a drink around the campfire in the lovely garden.
